session_start.description: Read wiki/hot.md if present and inject as preamble. Silent if no cache yet.

session_stop.description: Refresh wiki/hot.md from current registry + optional stdin summary of the just-completed session.

user_prompt_submit.description: Per-prompt wiki recall: FTS the user's prompt (read from stdin) against the active vault and inject top hits when relevant (recall.mode=auto). Silent otherwise. Host-neutral; wire into each host's prompt hook (Claude Code settings.json UserPromptSubmit, etc.).
